$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation and autocomplete.

id.description: Stable Proxyma agent UUID used as the JWT subject and key ID.

shared_secret.description: Shared secret used to sign short-lived Proxyma JWTs.

enabled.description: Whether this agent can authenticate to Proxyma.

user_ids.description: Proxyma user IDs that own this agent.

interaction_instance_id.description: Interaction instance id used for this agent's approval requests. Use local or a UUID v4 from interactions/<provider>/*.json. Omit to use the built-in local console interaction.
